activeRecallQuiz.scenario: A stock is in a major downtrend, then bounces slowly over 6 weeks between two converging lines that both slant sharply upward on shrinking volume. What pattern is this, and which way will it break?
activeRecallQuiz.question: A stock is in a major downtrend, then bounces slowly over 6 weeks between two converging lines that both slant sharply upward on shrinking volume. What pattern is this, and which way will it break?
activeRecallQuiz.correctAnswer: It is a Rising Wedge acting as a bearish continuation pattern. Because it slopes upward against the prevailing downtrend on weak volume, it will break downward.
activeRecallQuiz.explanation: Applying grounded principles prevents catastrophic losses and capital depletion.

coreTakeaways: Always evaluate underlying market assumptions before entering positions.
